title: Passive
wikitext:
{{disambig}}

[[Passive]] is a characteristic that might refer to a game mechanic that operates without active intervention by the player, the [[AI]] or a [[creature trait]]. For more information, see the relevant article:

; Passive skills
* [[Monster skill#List of monster skills|Passive monster skill]]s that are ''always on'', e.g. [[Duncan's Defense]] or [[Undead Sensitivity to Light]].
* [[Title effect|Passive title skill]]s produce a constant [[effect]] when a character displays a relevant title, e.g [[Stout-Hearted]] from displaying [[Deldrimor rank]].

; Passive creatures
* [[Foe#Passive foe|Passive foes]] are creatures that appear either green or red in the [[compass]], can be [[target]]ed by offensive skills, and do not [[aggro]] unless [[damage]]d or targeted with a skill by the [[party]]. All [[charmable animal]]s are passive foes.
* [[Passive spirit]]s create an [[area of effect]] while alive or upon death, e.g. the [[Spirit of Union]] created by [[Union]].

; Passive game mechanics
* [[Guide_to_Hero_Basics_and_Optimization#Combat_modes|Passive mode]] is an unofficial term for [[hero]]es that have been instructed to ''Avoid Combat''.
